decision_limits: A local precondition result is not a physicalPASS.
Three actual intervals and three centroid layers are only the declared fixture precondition; process-zone adequacy requires separate evidence.
An attractive or smooth section image is not used by any gate.

local_scope.scope_note: Only the supplied local patch and listed sample rays were examined; no local result is promoted to a whole-body result.

actual_h_over_t_distribution.interpretation: Descriptive max-edge / sampled-wall-thickness ratio; it does not replace measured interval or centroid-layer evidence.

engineering_precondition.rationale: This review declared a three-interval local mesh-precondition for the fixture; crack-process-zone adequacy is material- and model-dependent and is not inferred.
engineering_precondition.universality: DECLARED_ENGINEERING_PRECONDITION_ONLY; NOT A UNIVERSAL CRACK-RESOLUTION RULE
